themes.name: Linen Frequency
themes.description: A Helsinki harbour morning rendered in fogged linen and tin-blue, where tall cold type floats above a quiet, paper-weight editorial grid.

props.title: Linen Frequency
props.subtitle: October 16, 2026 — Helsinki harbour, fogged and still

props.text: Cold type floats on paper weight. The harbour doesn't announce itself — it simply persists, linen-grey and unhurried, until you notice the tin in the sky.

themes.name: Tarnished Register
themes.description: A late-night graphic poster conceived as a jazz club bill: near-black field, tarnished brass headline, oxblood cut against ivory—precision at the service of atmosphere.

props.text: A jazz club bill printed past midnight. Brass headline, oxblood cut, ivory ground — the atmosphere is the precision.
Doors at 9. Cover: two drinks. No requests.
Footer split. No ornament. Just the bill.

themes.name: Slab Hour
themes.description: A Brazilian modernist terrace translated into night: generous sculptural type, deep canopy tones, and one turquoise accent cutting through terracotta warmth.

props.text: A modernist terrace at nightfall — sculptural slabs carving light from deep canopy, one turquoise blade splitting the terracotta dark.

themes.name: Wet Geometry
themes.description: Rain-slick structure meets warm evening glow — dense technical grid breathing through generous rhythm.

body.name: IBM Plex Sans
body.stack: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

props.text: Rain-slick structure meets warm evening glow. The grid breathes slowly. Bracket-linked, flat-planed, retro-footed — this is technical warmth.
IBM Plex Sans — dense technical rhythm

themes.name: Raw Aperture
themes.description: Brutalist weight meets gallery grace — monolithic type sliced by a single saturated wound of color, images breathing inside generous shadow-edged frames.

props.text: Monolithic type sliced by a single saturated wound. Images breathe inside shadow-edged frames. This is brutalism with a gallery pass.

themes.name: Kiln & Morning
themes.description: A sun-warmed editorial reading surface built from tin-glaze whites, mineral blue ink, and terracotta — as if the page were fired ceramic, each section a glazed tile in a handmade sequence.

props.text: The page as fired ceramic — each section a glazed tile, mineral ink pressed into warm tin-white clay, terracotta smoldering at the edges.

themes.name: Aqua Proof
themes.description: A graphic poster distilled from optimistic Y2K terminals — oversized type cuts through a pale morning field like acid aqua scanlines on brushed paper.

props.text: Acid aqua scanlines cut through brushed paper. Y2K optimism rebooted at dawn — high contrast, zero apology.
Terminal optimism, typeset in Syne. Body set in Crimson Text.
